title: Co-op camera turning: player 1 flicks, three camera modes (DPC 0.9.172-dev20)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party, open ground, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Six tough goblins will be spawned. About 3 minutes. Steps with a checklist last until done; End (keyboard) ends any step early.

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.aim: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.cfg.coop_aim == true
probes.dbg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.ta_dbg or '')
probes.p2t: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.coop.tgt_name or 'none')
probes.pin: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.pin ~= nil
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1 ~= nil
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.flicks: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.ta.flick_n or 0) or 0
probes.cam: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.cfg.coop_cam_turn)
probes.camn: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.cct.n or 0) or 0
probes.flips: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.cct.flips or 0) or 0
probes.f1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.ta.f1 and (D.R.ta.f1.flick_n or 0) or 0
probes.yaw: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local y = D and D.R.cam_yaw(); return y and math.floor(math.deg(y) + 0.5)

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen).
Six tough goblins: left, ahead, right. MODE 1 (player 1's camera): PLAYER 1 turns the camera as normal. Then R3 on a goblin to keep it.
MODE 1: PLAYER 1 quick FLICKS left and right: his marker moves one goblin per flick, the camera doesn't spin. Leave the stick alone a moment: the camera turns toward his target. End when happy.
MODE 2 (both sticks): BOTH players push the right stick SLOWLY: either one turns the camera (both together add up). Quick flicks only switch your own target. End when happy.
MODE 3 (automatic): sticks only target now. Both keep targets on different goblins and walk around: the camera turns by itself toward your targets. End when happy.
MODE 3: PLAYER 1 click R3 on his target to release; PLAYER 2 tap R3 to go automatic. Walk somewhere together: the camera should turn to the way you're going.
Back to MODE 1. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. Tell Claude which mode felt best, and whether the automatic turning went the right way.
